title: Worktree merges can false-fail smoke on gitignored shots

owner_note.text: This merge first reported "smoke test failed; nothing merged" — 404s for `*/shots/*.png` and `public/data/panels.json`, all gitignored, so a fresh worktree lacks them while the main tree has them. Copying those dirs from the main tree into the worktree made smoke green. A durable fix is to have Server/worktree-up.mjs seed each new worktree with those gitignored asset dirs.
